{{Quote|Their Order might have already been decimated had it not been for the setback Darth Gravid dealt the Sith.|Darth Plagueis, to Darth Sidious, regarding Darth Gravid's role in hindering the Grand Plan against the Jedi Order|<ref name="DP" />}}
'''Darth Gravid''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who [[Sith Master|reigned]] as the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] in the lineage of the [[Order of the Sith Lords]]. During his tenure as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], Gravid took a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] female as his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], naming her [[Darth Gean]]. Over [[Time/Legends|time]], he was drawn to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] and began to lose his sanity as a result of attempting to combine some of the philosophies of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] enemies, with his teachings. [[Darth]] Gravid became convinced that he had to sabotage the Sith teachings in order to preserve the Sith. Around [[533 BBY]], Gravid destroyed the majority of the Sith's lore before Gean [[Duel in Darth Gravid's bastion|slew]] him in his [[Darth Gravid's bastion|bastion]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jaguada/Legends|Jaguada]]. Gravid's actions against the Sith set them back for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Only once in these past thousand years has a Sith Lord strayed into the light, and one day I ''will'' tell you that tale.|Darth Plagueis, to Darth Sidious, about Gravid's story|<ref name="DP" />}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] known as [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Gravid ruled as the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]<ref name="DP" /> around [[533 BBY]].<ref name="Note" /> Gravid was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] in the [[Order of the Sith Lords]],<ref name="DP" /> which [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] initiated in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].<ref name="DB: PoD">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref> He owned a collection of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] lore and also possessed the [[Force power/Legends|knowledge]] of [[essence transfer]], which enabled a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] to transfer one's consciousness into another body. Gravid eventually gained a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] female as his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], naming her [[Darth Gean]]. He and Gean constructed a [[Darth Gravid's bastion|bastion]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jaguada/Legends|Jaguada]].<ref name="DP" />

[[File:Transfer_in_clone_body_BoS.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Darth Gravid destroyed generations of Sith knowledge on Jaguada, including all traces of the essence transfer ability (pictured).]]
However, Gravid came to believe that absolute commitment to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] would be the Sith Order's undoing. He began to incorporate altruism and empathy, which were doctrines of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;the enemies of the Sith&mdash;into his teachings and practices. During that process, Gravid began to lose his sanity and eventually came to the conclusion that the only way the Sith Order would be preserved is that if the Sith teachings, [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifacts]], and [[Sith holocron/Legends|holocrons]] amassed through the generations were either hidden or destroyed. Gravid reasoned that once that was done, he would be able to guide the Sith into what he viewed as a more successful path.<ref name="DP" /> At some point around 533 BBY,<ref name="Note" /> Gravid used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to raise [[Force barrier/Legends|barriers]] around his bastion and began to destroy all the artifacts, [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]], and tomes that were in his possession.<ref name="DP" />

Gravid was interrupted by his apprentice, Gean, who had penetrated the barriers around their stronghold so that she could stop her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] from destroying the Sith's resources of knowledge. In the ensuing [[Duel in Darth Gravid's bastion|duel]], Gravid managed to severely injure the Twi'lek by cleaving off one of her [[Limb/Legends|arms]] and shoulders as well as the left side of her face and chest. Eventually, Gean managed to overpower Gravid, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him despite her being unarmed. Although he was slain, the impact of Gravid's actions in destroying the majority of Sith lore would be felt by the Sith Order for generations, hindering the [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]] that Darth Bane had initiated to eliminate the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and topple the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Nearly five [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] after Gravid's demise, the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] recounted Gravid's actions against the Sith to his apprentice, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="DP" />

==Personality and traits==
During his reign as Dark Lord, Darth Gravid was drawn to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] and began to believe that the Sith's absolute dedication to the dark side was a flaw. He attempted to introduce Jedi characteristics into his lifestyle and teachings. However, Gravid began to lose his sanity as a result, and he believed that it was necessary for the destruction of Sith lore so that he could mold the Order to his teachings.<ref name="DP" />

==Powers and abilities==
Gravid was sensitive to the Force and was powerful enough to ascend to the rank of Dark Lord of the Sith. He also possessed the knowledge of essence transfer, which gave the user the ability to transfer his or her consciousness into another host. He was capable of raising barriers with the Force that were large enough to cover his bastion. During his confrontation with Darth Gean, Gravid managed to cleave off his apprentice's left arm, shoulder, face, and torso, severely crippling her before he was killed by the Twi'lek.<ref name="DP" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Gravid was an invention of mine. I needed some way to distance Plagueis from the ancient teachings and powers. The more I thought about Gravid, the more interesting his/her story became. In my mind, at any rate.|James Luceno|<ref name="Luceno">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/latestnews/story/James_Luceno_Facebook_QA_Recap_143276.asp|text=TheForce.Net - Latest News - James Luceno Facebook Q&A Recap|author=Geller, Eric|date=2012-01-25|work=[[TheForce.net]]|archivedate=20120228045820}}</ref>}}
Darth Gravid was introduced in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], written by [[James Luceno]], who created Gravid to provide an explanation as to why the titular character, Darth Plagueis, did not have access to some of the old Sith teachings and Force techniques.<ref name="Luceno" />
